data.title: About Lesly
bio: I've been in Jersey for over 20 years and have 3 sons that I'm proud to shape into Men.  I am able to communicate in French, Russian, Spanish and English.  It's a rewarding experience to assist others to transition in and out homes, taking the next step in their lives.  Something of which I started 20 years ago.

Also, I take great pride in helping those start the process by providing guidance on shaping their credit.  Or helping those with recommend personnel for repairs.  I believe firmly in having Win-Win situations.  Outside of being a Realtor, I do Tech/IT work and enjoy looking for ways to simplify processes/routines.
I am also good with carpentry, mechanically inclined, and enjoy teaching others.  I enjoy spending times with kids and teaching this next generation how to be more versatile.  I also like to travel.
